verses.text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, set to a victory song.
LORD, I have heard what you have done and stand in awe of it. LORD, do that work again in our time; make it known in our days. In your anger, remember mercy.
God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the skies, and the earth was filled with his praise. Selah.
His brightness was like sunlight; rays flashed from his hand, where his power was hidden.
Plague went ahead of him, and pestilence followed close behind.
He stopped, and the earth shook. He looked, and nations trembled. Ancient mountains crumbled; hills from long ago sank down. His ways are everlasting.
I saw Cushan’s tents in distress; the shelters of Midian’s land shook.
LORD, were you angry with the rivers? Was your fury against the rivers or your rage against the sea, when you rode out with your horses and chariots of victory?
You uncovered your bow and called for its sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
The mountains saw you and shook. Torrents of water swept past; the deep roared and lifted its hands high.
The sun and moon stood still in the sky as your arrows flashed by and your shining spear gleamed.
You marched across the earth in anger and trampled the nations in your fury.
You went out to save your people, to rescue your anointed one. You crushed the leader of the wicked land and stripped him from head to foot. Selah.
You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They rushed in like a storm to scatter me, celebrating as if they could secretly devour the poor.
You rode your horses through the sea, churning the mighty waters.
I heard, and my body shook; my lips trembled at the sound. My bones felt rotten, and I shook where I stood. I will wait quietly for the day of trouble, when the invading people come against us.

Even if the fig tree does not blossom and the vines have no grapes, even if the olive crop fails, the fields produce no food, the flocks disappear from the pens, and there are no cattle in the stalls,
still I will celebrate the LORD; I will rejoice in the God who saves me!
The Lord GOD is my strength. He makes my feet steady like a deer’s and helps me walk on the heights. For the music director: with my stringed instruments.
